newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Spokesman Jean Christophe Filori said the EU's standing committee for food agreed on Thursday to include genetically modified maize and soya in the list of products covered by the novel food directive.

Spokesman Peter Guilford briefed on the fifth transatlantic meeting on Thursday on the U.S. Helms-Burton act, saying talks had been constructive and that both sides agreed to meet again the week of September 15.
Spokesman Thierry Daman confirmed that the Commission received France's revised recovery plan for Credit Lyonnais late on Thursday, but declined to comment further.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/735: Wide-screen TV action plan bows out - results of final call for proposals and World Cup football in wide-screen (Corrected version)
- IP/97/736: Commission launches 146 regional and urban pilot projects
- IP/97/737: Commission clears a joint venture between Daimler-Benz and Deutsche Telekom
- Eurostat news release No 55/97: EU farm prices in 1996
- Eurostat news release No 56/97: EU women average fertility rate
